scope: Omadora edge candidates only. No local package builds, RC/stable promotion or package installation.
ci_results: Both complete CI workflows succeeded; candidate run submitted exactly 16 recipes, checksum-fix run submitted only Claude Code. Current suite has 20 unit tests plus reconciliation, AppImage and core RPM packaging checks.

claude-code.reason: Source manifest rejected changed vendor legal-and-compliance.md; binary download checksum passed. Reviewed current official document and refreshed its hash; no checksum checks were disabled. Replacement 11234496 succeeded.

channel_protection.ci_webhook_capability: GitHub Actions secret COPR_EDGE_WEBHOOK_URL, validated against the edge project ID. No COPR API token exposed to CI.
channel_protection.promotions: RC and stable remain evidence-gated manual promotions; core pair keeps its existing coordinated manual edge procedure.

exclusions_and_pending_assessments.asus-zenbook-a16-firmware: New aarch64-only ASUS Snapdragon X2 UX3607OA DSP and ath12k board firmware, extracted from a vendor Windows BSP without execution. Outside the Fedora 44 x86_64 target; no RPM/COPR definition added.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.alsa-ucm-conf-aurora: Reviewed 10.aurora3 source pin and upstream aarch64 hardware changes. This Asahi/Qualcomm ARM audio integration remains outside the x86_64 target.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.linux-aurora: Reviewed integration/aurora source-pin changes. Fedora/Nobara kernel remains the native provider; ARM integration kernel not ported to x86_64 COPR.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.linux-omarchy: Reviewed 7.2.14 patch-series refresh and removal of BORE suffix in kernel package name. Fedora/Nobara native kernel retained; Arch kernel recipe remains not applicable.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.linux-omarchy-bore: Reviewed 7.2.14 scheduler/kernel pin. Fedora/Nobara kernel provider retained rather than an Arch kernel package.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.linux-omarchy-eevdf: Reviewed 7.2.14 kernel base and associated patch refresh. Fedora/Nobara kernel provider retained; no additional Arch-kernel RPM.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.linux-omarchy-muqss: Reviewed 7.2.14 kernel base pin. Fedora/Nobara kernel provider retained; no additional Arch-kernel RPM.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.linux-omarchy-aarch64: Reviewed Zenbook A16 enablement, QCC2072 power/firmware/device-tree patches and ARM kernel config changes. Outside Fedora 44 x86_64 scope.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.omarchy-ane-dkms: Reviewed 0.5.7 Apple Neural Engine module update. Apple Silicon aarch64/Arch DKMS integration remains outside x86_64 target.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.omarchy-dev: Upstream development pin advanced to bda3aaf. Fedora core remains built from the separate full Omadora pin and coordinated core recipes, not the Arch development PKGBUILD.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.omarchy-settings-dev: Development pin advanced to bda3aaf; Fedora uses its own core settings integration and Omadora pin. No duplicate Arch development-settings RPM added.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.qcom-firmware-extract: Reviewed Windows-ranked node-specific driver firmware selection and regression tests. Qualcomm aarch64 hardware integration is outside x86_64 scope.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.surface-snapdragon-addresses: Reviewed renamed Wi-Fi interface handling, rules rename and tests. Surface Snapdragon aarch64-only integration remains outside x86_64 scope.
exclusions_and_pending_assessments.sunshine: New upstream x86_64 default requires CUDA instead of autodetection. Existing Fedora 2026.914.233613-2 remains published with CUDA disabled. Porting/enabling the Fedora CUDA build toolchain and qualifying encoder/runtime behavior is unfinished; marked pending and excluded from submissions rather than claiming equivalence.
